sentences.en: The road tends to the south at the next village.
sentences.zh: 在下一个村庄，这条路将向南延伸。

sentences.en: In general, people in America tend to prefer bigger cars.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，美国人倾向于更喜欢大车。

sentences.en: Younger Cubans tend to tune into the American television network.
sentences.zh: 年轻的古巴人倾向于收看美国的电视网络。
